description: This Java class 'Security' provides security-related utility methods for the OpenMRS project, including password hashing, hashing comparison, token generation, and encryption/decryption functions.

classes.name: Security
classes.description: A utility class for handling password hashing, comparison, random token generation, and encryption/decryption.

methods.name: hashMatches
methods.description: Compares a stored hashed password with a given string by hashing the string with multiple algorithms and comparing.

methods.name: encodeString
methods.description: Hashes a string using SHA-512 algorithm and returns its hexadecimal representation.

methods.name: encodeStringSHA1
methods.description: Hashes a string using SHA-1 algorithm.

methods.name: getRandomToken
methods.description: Generates a secure random token encoded as a hex string.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts text using a specified initialization vector and secret key.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts text using a specified initialization vector and secret key.

methods.name: getSavedInitVector
methods.description: Retrieves the stored initialization vector for encryption.

methods.name: generateNewInitVector
methods.description: Generates a new random initialization vector.

methods.name: getSavedSecretKey
methods.description: Retrieves the stored secret key for encryption.

methods.name: generateNewSecretKey
methods.description: Generates a new secret key for encryption.
